expectations.text: A valid .docx file exists in outputs/ that python-docx can open and that contains at least one table
expectations.evidence: CPAS.24th-fai-egc_summary_report_2026-07-24.docx opens with python-docx; 22 paragraphs, 2 tables (overview + daily).

expectations.text: The report states 9 flying days between 8 and 22 July 2026 (8, 9, 10, 13, 16, 17, 18, 20, 22 Jul)
expectations.evidence: States 9 days: 8, 9, 10, 13, 16, 17, 18, 20, 22 July 2026, with the gaps identified as non-flying days.

expectations.text: Airspace incursions are reported as zero AND the report explicitly notes that incursion analysis is disabled in the CPAS competition settings (incursions: false)
expectations.evidence: Zero incursions per day plus explicit caveat: 'the airspace-incursion analysis is switched OFF (incursions = false)... A disabled detector is not evidence of a clean competition.'

expectations.text: Per-class handling is correct: the report either discovers the case-sensitive class names (Club, Standard) via the CPAS task endpoint and attributes days/events accordingly, or at minimum does not fabricate per-class event counts (encounter/incursion records carry no class labels)
expectations.evidence: Did not fabricate counts, but makes the false claim 'CPAS holds no task or class definitions for this competition - task queries for every plausible class name (club, standard, 15m, 18m, 20m, open) return 404'. Capitalised names Club/Standard return task data; the old skill guidance caused lowercase-only probing.

expectations.text: Proximity encounters (55 total, peaks on 13 Jul with 19 and 22 Jul with 21) are reported as distinct from airspace incursions, never conflated
expectations.evidence: 55 encounters 'NOT incursions', per-day column (19 on 13 Jul, 21 on 22 Jul), closest 7.3 m, review tags reported.

expectations.text: A per-day weather summary is present covering the flown days (temperature, precipitation and/or wind), plus a narrative of the forecast evolution
expectations.evidence: Per-day weather columns (Tmax/Tmin, precip, wind) plus a three-phase forecast narrative with weather-vs-activity correlation.

expectations.text: Total flights reported is 582 (or per-day counts 47/14/70/84/84/84/83/33/83)
expectations.evidence: Total flights 582 in overview, text, and daily-table Total row; per-day counts match ground truth.
